system.name: KG-Agent
system.one_liner: An autonomous agent in which a small tuned LLM picks KG tools step by step, with an executor and a knowledge memory, trained on synthesized program data.

content.variant_note: a planner, toolbox and executor triangle beside a four-step trace on a real question, above a strip that derives tuning data from a query graph
content.argues: A small LLM can reason over a KG by calling tools one step at a time while a memory is updated, and its tuning data can be synthesized from query graphs.
content.subject: Top half: planner, toolbox, executor and knowledge memory over steps t=1 to 4 on one question. Bottom half: query graph, reasoning program and tuning pairs.

elements.name: Planner
elements.role: the instruction-tuned LLM that decides the next function call and finally the answer

elements.name: Toolbox
elements.role: the set of KG functions the planner can call

elements.name: Executor
elements.role: runs the chosen function on the KG and returns the result
elements.drawn_as: robot-arm-and-rocket icon, bold name under it, thick grey arrows from the toolbox and back to the planner

elements.name: Autonomous Reasoning

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the agent as a triangle of large named icons next to a per-step trace that reuses the icons small, and colour graph regions and the code lines they generate alike, so the derivation of training data can be followed by colour.
lessons.suits: Tool-using agents whose tuning data are synthesized from a structure (graph, plan, program), showing both the run-time loop and the data derivation in one figure.

summary: KG-Agent lets a small instruction-tuned LLM answer complex questions over a knowledge graph by choosing tools one step at a time. The top half of Figure 1 follows a real question about Cristiano Ronaldo: a llama-mascot Planner, a Toolbox and an Executor form a triangle, while a knowledge memory (question, toolbox definition, history program, current KG information) is updated over steps t=1 to 4 as the planner emits function calls and the executor returns results. Below a dashed line, the data synthesis is shown: a query graph grounded on Freebase, YAGO or Wikidata becomes a colour-coded KG reasoning program, whose calls turn into Input and Output pairs in a prompt template.
summary_zh: KG-Agent 让小模型自主选工具，在知识图谱上逐步推理。上半部分用真实问题展示规划器、工具箱、执行器三角循环和随 t=1 到 4 更新的知识记忆；下半部分展示由查询图生成彩色推理程序，再转成输入输出训练对。
notes: The paper cites parts (a), (b), (c) of the figure but no letters are printed, so the two halves are recorded as unlabelled panels. Whether the llama avatar is generated or stock cannot be told from the figure; it is listed under generated as an illustrated mascot.
